why: Physics tutorials are a structured instance of collaborative learning in which small groups work together on guided conceptual tasks, with teaching assistants facilitating rather than lecturing.
This is a specific tutor-completed assessment instrument rather than a general instructional element, and it is not reducible to the broader Performance-Based Assessment page.
name: University of the West Indies PBL tutorial assessment rating scale
product_description: A six-point, 13-item tutor rating scale developed and used by the University of the West Indies to assess medical students’ participation, problem-solving, self-directed learning, critical-thinking, and teamwork in PBL tutorials.
